<rimay>
The System shall include the "archive" flag and the "blocked" flag of each message in the ".xml backup".
When the System imports messages from an ".xml backup", then the System shall place each previously archived message in the "archive" folder.
When the System imports messages from an ".xml backup", then the System shall restore the "blocked" flag of each previously blocked message.
</rimay>
